title: Two Coworkers Two Replacement Faces
tests: Tests explicit multi-face mapping and stable identity tracking across a two-person video without changing the original scene or sound.

faults.what: Neither replacement recognizably matches the supplied portrait: the foreground man has a much younger, differently shaped face, and the woman's facial features do not match portrait-woman.jpg.

The center coworker's face was also altered: his prominent original beard and facial features have changed, although the request was to replace the two specified faces and leave everything else unchanged.

judge.summary: The output retains a roughly ten-second office scene but uses the wrong replacement identities and also changes the center coworker's face.

must_haves.item: The output contains the full 10-second office exchange from talk-two.mp4.
must_haves.why: The output is 10.1 seconds and the sampled frames show the office interaction, but one source frame cannot establish that the entire original exchange is preserved.

must_haves.item: The male coworker's face recognizably matches portrait-man.jpg and the female coworker's face recognizably matches portrait-woman.jpg.
must_haves.why: The visible replacement faces do not recognizably reproduce either supplied portrait's facial features.

must_haves.item: The two replacement identities never switch between coworkers or collapse into the same face.
must_haves.why: The foreground man and woman retain distinct, consistent-looking faces across the four supplied output frames, with no visible identity exchange.

must_haves.item: Both faces stay aligned through head turns and speaking, without conspicuous flickering or original-face reappearance.
must_haves.why: The faces appear attached and aligned in the sampled head positions, but still frames cannot establish flicker-free tracking or rule out original-face reappearance between samples.

must_haves.item: The original office, bodies, clothing, camera movement and shot timing remain unchanged.
must_haves.why: The office setting and visible clothing appear consistent with the source frame, but original camera movement, body motion and shot timing cannot be compared from the single source image.

must_haves.item: Both original voices remain audible and synchronized, with no added music or narration.
must_haves.why: The sound report confirms audible speech, but supplies only one transcribed sentence and no source-audio comparison or information sufficient to verify both voices, synchronization, or absence of added audio.
